question: Which materials are listed as suitable origins for ritual vessels?
premises: A vessel made of clay is included
A vessel born of tortoise is included
Vessels made of bell-metal and copper-metal are included
inference: Ritual vessels may be made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell-metal, or copper-metal
